operations.description: Using this method, you can create a particular maintenance schedules

400.description: Invalid request parameters or request body

422.description: A maintenance schedule with the same key already exists

id.description: Identifier generated by the server for this schedule.

key.description: Schedule key provided by user. Cannot be null during creation.

maintenance-schedule.description: Represents a maintenance schedule during which resources are set to 'maintained' state. The server inturn informs the adapters that monitor these resources to stop monitoring until specified otherwise.Each maintenance schedule has an id, key and schedule. Both id and key have to be unique within the system. While id is automatically assigned by the server, key must be specified by the user.

hour.description: The beginning hour of the schedule.

minuteOfTheHour.description: The beginning minutes of the schedule.

duration.description: Duration of the schedule in minutes.

recurrence.description: Configures how the schedule is repeated within the provided interval.

dayOfTheMonth.description: Deprecated day of the month. Applicable to MONTHLY schedules and mutually exclusive with daysOfTheMonth and weeksOfTheMonth.

daysOfTheMonth.description: Days of the month for a MONTHLY schedule; values are 1 through 31 or LAST.

weeksOfTheMonth.description: Week indices for a MONTHLY schedule.

daysOfTheWeek.description: Days of the week for a WEEKLY or MONTHLY schedule.

month.description: Deprecated month of the year, mutually exclusive with months.

months.description: Months of the year for the schedule.

startDate.description: Start date for the schedule. Should be in format MM/DD/YYYY and if not specified current date is used.

expirationDate.description: The expiration date in MM/DD/YYYY; mutually exclusive with expireRuns.

timeZone.description: Time Zone of the schedule. If not provided, defaults to the time of the VMware Cloud Foundation Operations server.

expireRuns.description: The number of runs after which the schedule expires; mutually exclusive with expirationDate.

schedule.description: Schedule represents the meta information required by the server to set resources in maintenance mode at the right interval/time.
